abstract: A 60-year-old man with advanced seminoma was treated with four cycles of a cisplatin, etoposide and bleomycin. He then developed severe pulmonary toxicity with diffuse infiltrates as evidenced on a chest x-ray film. The room air PaO2 value was 32 mm Hg. The patient was treated with steroids and oxygen supplementation, including a high FIo2 for several days, and survived and eventually experienced marked improvement in his pulmonary status. Aggressive management of severe bleomycin-induced pneumonitis appears justified.
abstract_ja: 60歳男性が進行セミノーマに対して、シスプラチン、エトポシド、ブレオマイシンによる化学療法を4サイクル施行された。その後、重篤な肺毒性を発症し、胸部X線写真でびまん性陰影を認めた。室内気下PaO2は32 mmHgであった。ステロイドおよび高FIO2を含む酸素投与を数日間行い、患者は生存し、肺病変は著明に改善した。重症のブレオマイシン誘発性肺炎に対する積極的な治療は正当化されると考えられる。
